title: Build Floquet evolution operators
action: Implement the tight-binding Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian for the 2D square lattice with open boundary conditions (Lx=Ly=25) including the d-wave pairing term Δ(k)=Δ0(cos kx - cos ky) and the periodic mass‑kick drive. Construct the exact Floquet evolution operator matrices U(T) = exp(-i H0 T) exp(-i m1 Γ1) for both B_x=0 and B_x=0.3 using the specified parameters: t_x=t_y=1.0, λ_x=λ_y=1.0, m0=2.5, Δ0=0.6, m1=-0.4, T=0.419. The operators are 5000×5000 sparse matrices. Save a checkpoint file for later use.
description: Construct the Floquet operators that will be diagonalized in subsequent steps. The evidence checkpoint confirms the construction but is not scored.

title: Floquet quasienergy spectrum for B_x = 0
action: Diagonalize the Floquet operator U(T) constructed in the previous step for the case B_x=0. Extract the Floquet quasienergies μ_m. Save the full sorted list of quasienergies to /app/outputs/quasienergy_bx0.json.
description: Full list of Floquet quasienergies for the 2D system with B_x=0, from exact diagonalization of the Floquet operator on a 25×25 lattice. Expected length is 5000.

title: Floquet quasienergy spectrum for B_x = 0.3
action: Diagonalize the Floquet operator U(T) for B_x=0.3. Save the sorted quasienergies to /app/outputs/quasienergy_bx03.json.
description: Full list of Floquet quasienergies for the 2D system with B_x=0.3, from exact diagonalization. Expected length is 5000.

title: Floquet Wannier spectrum
action: Build the effective high-frequency Floquet Hamiltonian in a slab geometry: open boundary conditions along x (25 sites) and periodic boundary conditions along y. Diagonalize it to obtain occupied Floquet states (quasienergy ≤ 0). Construct the Wilson loop operator along k_y and compute the Wannier spectrum eigenvalues ν. Repeat for both B_x=0 and B_x=0.3. Save results as a JSON object at /app/outputs/fws.json with keys 'Bx0' and 'Bx03', each mapping to an array of eigenvalues.
description: Floquet Wannier spectrum eigenvalues for both Zeeman field cases, used to identify the topological nature (quantized eigenvalues at 0.5 indicate SOTSC phases).
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'Bx0' and 'Bx03', each an array of real numbers in [0,1)

title: Floquet quadrupole moment
action: Using the eigenstates of the exact Floquet operator from the first process step with full open boundary conditions (Lx=Ly=25), construct the many-body ground state by occupying all states with quasienergy ≤ 0. Compute the Floquet quadrupole moment Q_{xy}^{Flq} modulo 1. Perform for B_x=0 and B_x=0.3. Save the two results as a JSON object at /app/outputs/fqm.json with keys 'Bx0' and 'Bx03', each a single real number.
description: Floquet quadrupole moment values (mod 1) for the weak phase (B_x=0) and the strong phase (B_x=0.3).
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'Bx0' and 'Bx03', each a single real number
